name: Dictador Colombian Aged Gin Ortodoxy
official_name: Dictador Colombian Aged Dry Gin Ortodoxy
production: Each botanical distilled separately, then blended
Aged 35 weeks in oak barrels previously used for rum (The Gin Is In)
expressions: Dictador Colombian Aged Gin Treasure | sibling aged gin
notes: Recipe formulated by Dario Parra, former president of Destilería Colombia, inspired by London dry gins from business trips to England. Tasting notes from Difford's (industry, 2015). Difford's gives no cask detail; cask/ageing from The Gin Is In (review site) [cần kiểm tra]. Backlog producer 'Destileria Colombiana' vs Difford's 'Destilería Colombia'.
